## Bucket v1alpha1

`apiVersion: platform.koorikla.io/v1alpha1`, `kind: Bucket`, scope Namespaced. Source: [packages/bucket/apis/bucket/definition.yaml](../../packages/bucket/apis/bucket/definition.yaml), package [README](../../packages/bucket/README.md) (status: layout).

### spec

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `versioning` | boolean |  | `false` | Keep every version of every object (recover overwrites and deletes). |
| `storageGiB` | integer |  | `10` | rustfs backend only - volume size of the local RustFS tenant. Can grow, never shrink. Range 1..4096. Rules: storageGiB can only grow. |
| `deletionPolicy` | string |  | `Retain` | Retain keeps the cloud bucket and its objects when the XR is deleted; Delete removes it. One of `Retain`, `Delete`. |

### status

| `backend` | string |  |  | rustfs \| aws-s3 \| gcp-storage \| azure-blob |

| `endpoint` | string |  |  |  |
| `secretName` | string |  |  | Connection Secret in this namespace (endpoint, bucket, region, accessKeyId, secretAccessKey). |

## KafkaTopic v1alpha1

`apiVersion: platform.koorikla.io/v1alpha1`, `kind: KafkaTopic`, scope Namespaced. Source: [packages/kafka-topic/apis/kafka-topic/definition.yaml](../../packages/kafka-topic/apis/kafka-topic/definition.yaml), package [README](../../packages/kafka-topic/README.md) (status: layout).

### spec

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `partitions` | integer |  | `3` | Partitions (consumer parallelism). Can grow, never shrink (Kafka cannot remove partitions). Range 1..100. Rules: partitions can only grow. |
| `retentionHours` | integer |  | `168` | How long records are kept (delete cleanup policy). Range 1..8760. |
| `cleanupPolicy` | string |  | `delete` | delete (time-based retention) or compact (keep the latest record per key). One of `delete`, `compact`. |
| `deletionPolicy` | string |  | `Retain` | Retain keeps the topic and its records when the XR is deleted; Delete removes them. One of `Retain`, `Delete`. |

### status

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `backend` | string |  |  | strimzi \| aws-msk \| gcp-managedkafka \| azure-eventhubs |
| `topic` | string |  |  | Topic name on the broker (<namespace>.<name>, unique per Kafka cluster). |
| `bootstrapServers` | string |  |  |  |
| `secretName` | string |  |  | Connection Secret in this namespace. |

## MySQL v1alpha1

`apiVersion: platform.koorikla.io/v1alpha1`, `kind: MySQL`, scope Namespaced. Source: [packages/mysql/apis/mysql/definition.yaml](../../packages/mysql/apis/mysql/definition.yaml), package [README](../../packages/mysql/README.md) (status: layout).

### spec

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | string |  | `8.4` | MySQL version (LTS). Upgrades only. One of `8.4`. |
| `size` | string |  | `S` | S \| M \| L: compute of each instance (operator resources, RDS / Cloud SQL / Flexible Server class). One of `S`, `M`, `L`. |
| `storageGiB` | integer |  | `10` | Storage per instance in GiB. Can grow, never shrink. Range 10..16384. Rules: storageGiB can only grow. |
| `highAvailability` | boolean |  | `false` | 3 instances with semi-synchronous replication locally; Multi-AZ / REGIONAL / zone-redundant in cloud. |
| `database` | string |  | `app` | Database to create; the app user has the same name (username in the Secret). Immutable. Range ..32 chars. Pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$`. Rules: database is immutable; database (also the username) must not be a reserved MySQL, operator or cloud name. |
| `deletionPolicy` | string |  | `Retain` | Retain keeps the cloud database when the XR is deleted; Delete removes it. One of `Retain`, `Delete`. |

### status

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `backend` | string |  |  | moco \| aws-rds \| gcp-cloudsql \| azure-flexible |
| `endpoint` | string |  |  |  |
| `port` | integer |  |  |  |
| `secretName` | string |  |  | Connection Secret in this namespace (host, port, database, username, password, uri). |

## PostgreSQL v1alpha1

`apiVersion: platform.koorikla.io/v1alpha1`, `kind: PostgreSQL`, scope Namespaced. Source: [packages/postgresql/apis/postgresql/definition.yaml](../../packages/postgresql/apis/postgresql/definition.yaml), package [README](../../packages/postgresql/README.md).

### spec

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | string |  | `17` | PostgreSQL major version. Upgrades only (no downgrade). One of `16`, `17`, `18`. Rules: version can only be raised. |
| `size` | string |  | `S` | S \| M \| L: compute of each instance (CNPG resources, RDS / Cloud SQL / Flexible Server class). One of `S`, `M`, `L`. |
| `storageGiB` | integer |  | `10` | Storage per instance in GiB. Can grow, never shrink (no backend shrinks volumes). Range 10..16384. Rules: storageGiB can only grow. |
| `highAvailability` | boolean |  | `false` | Standby in another zone with automatic failover: 3 CNPG instances, RDS Multi-AZ (Aurora: a reader in another AZ), Cloud SQL REGIONAL, Flexible Server zone-redundant HA. |
| `backup` | object |  | `{}` |  |
| `backup.enabled` | boolean |  | `false` | Automated backups with point-in-time recovery (CNPG needs an object store on the cluster). |
| `backup.retentionDays` | integer |  | `7` | Range 7..35. |
| `database` | string |  | `app` | Database to create; its owner role has the same name and is the username in the connection Secret. Immutable. Range ..63 chars. Pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$`. Rules: database is immutable; database (also the owner role) must not be a reserved PostgreSQL or cloud role name. |
| `engine` | string |  | `postgres` | aws-rds backend only: postgres (RDS instance, Multi-AZ for HA) or aurora (Aurora PostgreSQL). Immutable. One of `postgres`, `aurora`. Rules: engine is immutable. |
| `deletionPolicy` | string |  | `Retain` | Retain keeps the cloud database (and enables deletion protection) when the XR is deleted; Delete removes it. CNPG data lives in PVCs owned by the Cluster and goes with the XR either way. One of `Retain`, `Delete`. |

### status

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `backend` | string |  |  | cnpg \| aws-rds \| gcp-cloudsql \| azure-flexible |
| `endpoint` | string |  |  | Hostname the database answers on. |
| `port` | integer |  |  |  |
| `secretName` | string |  |  | Connection Secret in this namespace (host, port, dbname, username, password, uri). |
| `backup` | string |  |  | enabled \| disabled \| unavailable (asked for, but this cluster has no backup target) |
